title: 第6章 惊天大发现
slug: 官榜全本免费-官榜最新章节列表
content_zh:
邢唐县在青林市的九个县城中虽然并不能排到首位,但却也不算是最后一个。作为地方县府,县城内还算很为繁华。像是黑山镇这样的乡镇村民,逢年过节都以能够来邢唐县县城逛逛为荣。
再穷的地方也有富的,再富的地方也有穷的,这就是最为客观的真理,邢唐县城自然也不例外。
苏沐差不多在快接近中午的时候赶到了邢唐县城,因为明天才要召开会议,今天闲着没事便四下转悠开来。
说到邢唐县,那不但在青林市,在全国都算小有名号。原因很简单,据说这里以前有着大量的古墓。谁家要是运气好的话,一镢头便能挖出一座古墓出来。只要能够捞到一件古董,那便算是赚大发了。
最初这些古墓没有谁在意,因为不懂,很多好玩意都被贱卖掉。等到邢唐县这些人意识到原来从地面刨出来的这些破烂玩意那么值钱的时候,却是已经迟了。这里的古墓早就被挖掘的一干二净,就算有剩下的也不是谁想找就能找到的。
当然瘦死的骆驼比马大,靠着这些古玩意,邢唐县城总算多出一道亮点。各种各样的老古董,充斥在古玩街上。有的是在商铺内摆着,有的干脆就是在地摊上放着。大家每天都在碰运气,一个月不开张不要紧,要知道这种行当只要一开张便顶别人好几个月。
来到邢唐县城,不逛逛古玩一条街,那算是没来过!
夏天的阳光很为毒辣,照射下来到处都弥漫着炙热的气息,就算是狗这时候都不愿意跑出来,全都窝在墙角,吐着舌头,大口大口的喘着气。
要是换做别的地方,肯定没有多少人。但作为邢唐县城的亮点,这条古玩街哪怕天这么热,也是有着络绎不绝的人群。要知道来这里的人,不但只是想着来逛逛古玩,还有其余做别的事的。
比如说有来自各个城镇的村民过来卖山货的,有各式各样的西洋镜在买卖,有爽的让人舒服的凉粉...总而言之一句话,古玩街既然是邢唐县城最热闹的地方,那么来这里做买卖便错不了。
做生意的谁不想去人多的地方?毕竟人多才意味着有客源,才能够将手里的东西卖出去换钱。
“县城始终是县城,黑山镇和这里相比简直差的不是一点半点。什么时候黑山镇要是能像邢唐县城这样,那该多好!”
苏沐站在古玩街口,瞧着眼前这条繁华的街道,心中猛地升起一股异样的念头。那就是回到黑山镇,要想尽办法的说服梁昌贵,争取在最短的时间内将黑山镇打造成为邢唐县城的明星乡镇。
其实对怎么发展黑山镇,苏沐心中早就有了一个框架,可惜这种发展的前提是需要大笔的金钱投入。没有投资作为前提,黑山镇根本别想成功的崛起。而就是这个至关重要的问题,成为最大的阻碍。
梁昌贵也好,杨松也好,都没有谁能做到拉来投资商。苏沐提过几次后,便心灰意冷,没有再说话。
不掌权,想做什么都处处受制。
不在其位不谋其政这话说的是不错,而这话其实还有一个更深层次的理解,那便是不在其位,不是不想谋其政,而是没办法谋。
“算了,先不想这些,既然来到这古玩一条街就好好的转转。没准我的运气好,还能捞到什么好东西那。”
苏沐摇摇头,随意向前走去。别看他来到黑山镇小半年,说到逛这古玩街还真是没几次。这里摆放的那些个小玩意,有的是本地出土,有的则是通过各种途径运到这里的。乱七八糟的大杂烩,便成了现在这样。
那些个商铺苏沐是不会去的,因为就算进去相中那件东西他也没有足够的钱买下。与其那样倒不如老实的逛逛路边摊,没准还能淘到好货色。要知道就算是那些个摊主,也没有谁敢说对古董这行当有多深的了解。

“嗨,小兄弟来我这里瞧瞧吧。看看有没有相中的东西?给你说,我这里的货色都很正宗,绝对不会让你失望而归的。”
苏沐在一个小摊前面停下,摊主是个肤色发黑身形瘦弱的男子,两只眼睛滴溜溜乱转,给人种很为精明的感觉。
“这都是些什么东西那?”苏沐蹲下身来随意的翻动着。
“全都是好货!”摊主笑着凑上前低声道:“小兄弟你知道的,我这里的东西全都是来自土里,绝对的货真价实。只要你有相中的,价钱好商量。我就当作是结交兄弟你这个人了,来,瞧瞧这块根雕,明朝的货。”

content_en:
Although Xingtang County is not ranked first among the nine counties in Qinglin City, it is not the last either. As a local county government, the county town is quite prosperous. Villagers in villages and towns like Heishan Town are proud to visit Xingtang County during the holidays.
No matter how poor the place is, there are rich people, and no matter how rich the place is, there are also poor people. This is the most objective truth, and Xingtang County is no exception.
Su Mu arrived at Xingtang County near noon. Because there was only a meeting tomorrow, she had nothing to do today so she wandered around.
Speaking of Xingtang County, it is well-known not only in Qinglin City, but also in the whole country. The reason is very simple. It is said that there used to be a large number of ancient tombs here. If anyone is lucky, they can dig out an ancient tomb with just a hoe. As long as you can catch an antique, you will make a lot of money.
At first, no one paid much attention to these ancient tombs. Because they didn't understand, many good things were sold at low prices. By the time the people in Xingtang County realized how valuable the junk they dug out of the ground was, it was already too late. The ancient tombs here have long been excavated, and even if there are any left, it is not easy for anyone to find them.
Of course, a skinny camel is bigger than a horse. With these antiques, Xingtang County finally has one more bright spot. All kinds of old antiques fill the antique street. Some are placed in shops, and some are simply placed on street stalls. Everyone is trying their luck every day. It doesn't matter if it doesn't open for a month. You must know that this kind of business can outperform others for several months once it opens.
When you come to Xingtang County, you have never been there without visiting the antique street!
The summer sun is very scorching, and everywhere it shines is filled with hot breath. Even the dogs are unwilling to run out at this time. They all sit in the corner, sticking out their tongues, and gasping for air.
If it were any other place, there wouldn't be many people there. But as the highlight of Xingtang County, this antique street has an endless stream of people even if the weather is so hot. You must know that people who come here not only want to browse antiques, but also do other things.
For example, there are villagers from various towns who come to sell mountain products, there are all kinds of dioramas for sale, there are refreshing jelly noodles that make people feel comfortable... In a word, since Antique Street is the most lively place in Xingtang County, it is a good idea to come here to do business.
Who doesn't want to go to a place with a lot of people when doing business? After all, a lot of people means there is a source of customers, so that you can sell the things you have in hand for money.
"The county seat is always the county seat. Compared with here, Heishan Town is not even the slightest bit worse. It would be great if Heishan Town could be like Xingtang County Town!"
Su Mu stood at the entrance of the antique street, looking at the bustling street in front of her, and a strange thought suddenly arose in her heart. That is to return to Heishan Town and try every means to persuade Liang Changgui and strive to build Heishan Town into a star township in Xingtang County in the shortest possible time.
In fact, Su Mu already had a framework in mind on how to develop Heishan Town. Unfortunately, such development required a large amount of money investment. Without investment as a prerequisite, Black Mountain Town would have no chance of successfully rising. And it is this crucial issue that becomes the biggest obstacle.
Neither Liang Changgui nor Yang Song can attract investors. After Su Mu mentioned it several times, he became disheartened and said no more.
If you don't have power, you will be restricted in everything you want to do.
It is true to say that if you are not in your position, you will not seek to achieve your political goals, but in fact there is a deeper understanding of this saying, that is, if you are not in your position, it is not that you do not want to seek your political affairs, but that you are unable to do so.
"Forget it, let's not think about these things for now. Now that we have come to this antique street, let's take a walk around it. Maybe if I'm lucky, I can catch something good."
Su Mu shook his head and walked forward casually. Even though he has been in Heishan Town for only half a year, when it comes to visiting this ancient town,It’s really rare to play in the streets. Some of the gadgets displayed here were unearthed locally, while others were transported here through various channels. The messy hodgepodge has become what it is now.
Su Mu would not go to those shops, because even if he went in, he wouldn't have enough money to buy the thing he found in the photo. Instead of doing that, it would be better to visit the roadside stalls honestly, and maybe you can find some good stuff. You must know that even among those stall owners, no one dares to say that they have a deep understanding of the antique industry.
"Hey, little brother, come and have a look at my place. Do you see anything you like? Let me tell you, the products I have here are all authentic and you will never be disappointed."
Su Mu stopped in front of a stall. The stall owner was a thin man with dark skin and a darting eye, giving him a very shrewd look.
"What are these things?" Su Mu knelt down and flipped through them casually.
"They are all good goods!" The stall owner smiled and walked forward and whispered: "Little brother, you know, all the things I have here come from the soil, and they are absolutely genuine. As long as you find something you like, the price is negotiable. I regard you as a friend. Come, take a look at this root carving, a product from the Ming Dynasty."
